title: Supervised validation accuracy versus epoch
interpretation: Seed means and 95% t intervals show early improvement and later method-specific changes; actual ViT-Tiny-dimension run is separate from the compact proxy.
limitations: Three seeds per model and epoch; intervals are wide for the actual 12-block ViT-Tiny.

title: Training time versus epoch, raw and adjusted
interpretation: The paired panels expose the 1,122.16 s ResNet-18 seed-11 interval and show its effect on mean wall time.
limitations: Adjusted panel subtracts the interval after epoch 2 as a sensitivity analysis only; its cause is unknown and the raw measure remains shown.

title: Marginal accuracy improvement per additional compute
interpretation: Marginal returns fluctuate and can be negative; uncertainty intervals make that variability visible.
limitations: Per-second metric is sensitive to wall-clock noise; only the adjusted diagnostic handles the ResNet anomaly interval.

title: Dataset-size scaling for MLP and LeNet
interpretation: LeNet improves across the two reported sizes; MLP is not monotone across its available range.
limitations: Only 30K and 58K requested-size points are plotted; three-seed intervals are imprecise.

title: Random Forest performance versus number of trees
interpretation: The curve shows validation accuracy over the native tree-count budget with seed uncertainty.
limitations: Warm-start forest runs; no interpretation as neural epochs.

title: MiniBatch K-Means multi-metric performance versus computational budget
interpretation: The panels keep external clustering metrics distinct; GMM log-likelihood is shown separately from clustering quality.
limitations: Seed means with 95% t intervals; K-Means reused-checkpoint duplicate rows are excluded; native update units are retained.

title: Gaussian Mixture Model multi-metric performance versus computational budget
interpretation: The panels keep external clustering metrics distinct; GMM log-likelihood is shown separately from clustering quality.
limitations: Seed means with 95% t intervals; K-Means reused-checkpoint duplicate rows are excluded; native update units are retained.

title: DBSCAN quality, fit time and noise versus dataset size
interpretation: Three matched panels show clustering agreement, fit time and noise share; individual fit-time seed observations are visible.
limitations: Three fit sizes and three seeds; this is descriptive evidence, not a runtime scaling law.

title: Validation reconstruction MSE versus training budget
interpretation: Validation reconstruction MSE is reported separately for each representation model.
limitations: Three seeds; reconstruction and downstream metrics answer different questions.

title: Downstream linear-probe accuracy versus training budget
interpretation: Downstream linear-probe accuracy is reported separately for each representation model.
limitations: Three seeds; reconstruction and downstream metrics answer different questions.

title: Semi-supervised performance versus labeled fraction
interpretation: Algorithm and label-fraction effects are shown at the shared 30-epoch endpoint with seed uncertainty.
limitations: Three seeds per condition; supervised baseline is plotted separately in Figure 21.

title: Semi-supervised performance versus training budget
interpretation: Methods have distinct trajectories at a common label fraction; uncertainty is shown across seeds.
limitations: Three seeds; task adaptations, not canonical implementations on standard SSL benchmark splits.

title: CartPole-v1 reward versus steps and time
interpretation: Algorithm-specific return trajectories are shown for CartPole-v1.
limitations: Seed counts differ by algorithm; separate environments and reward scales; logged elapsed time is hardware/protocol specific.

title: Pendulum-v1 reward versus steps and time
interpretation: Algorithm-specific return trajectories are shown for Pendulum-v1.
limitations: Seed counts differ by algorithm; separate environments and reward scales; logged elapsed time is hardware/protocol specific.

title: Full WikiText-2 perplexity versus parameter count
interpretation: The Pythia checkpoints have lower measured perplexity at larger model sizes in this selected set.
limitations: Six checkpoints across families; training data and tokenizer differ; parameter count is not training compute.

title: Pythia-70M checkpoint-prefix evaluation trajectory
interpretation: Loss across selected released checkpoints is shown on a symlog step axis so step zero remains visible.
limitations: Restricted local-text prefix and single evaluations; step-to-token mapping is published metadata, not measured local training compute.

title: Pythia-160M checkpoint-prefix evaluation trajectory
interpretation: Loss across selected released checkpoints is shown on a symlog step axis so step zero remains visible.
limitations: Restricted local-text prefix and single evaluations; step-to-token mapping is published metadata, not measured local training compute.

title: Zero-shot benchmark results (full validation splits)
interpretation: All available validation examples are shown by task with score uncertainty and sample counts.
limitations: One model and three tasks; task scores are not pooled; smoke-test subsets are excluded.

title: Cross-paradigm within-task changes
interpretation: Each panel shows seed-paired absolute change from its own first checkpoint; accuracy is in percentage points, while RL and reconstruction retain native units.
limitations: Panels do not share a metric or cost scale; budget order is ordinal and series baselines differ.

title: Supervised performance versus cumulative compute time
interpretation: Matched seed means of accuracy and cumulative time show task-specific performance-cost trajectories.
limitations: Time is elapsed runtime, not energy/FLOPs; the ResNet seed-11 interval is removed only in this adjusted diagnostic.

title: Semi-supervised method versus supervised baseline
interpretation: Pseudo-labeling is compared with the labeled-only MLP under matched fractions, seeds, and the registered 30-epoch endpoint.
limitations: Three seeds per fraction; this ablation is separate from the multi-method SSL study.

title: Representation quality versus reconstruction-model training cost
interpretation: Linear-probe performance is plotted against paired cumulative training time for each representation model.
limitations: Three seeds; the probe is a separate downstream assessment and not a universal representation metric.

title: Perplexity versus comparable full-test evaluation time
interpretation: The same local device, precision, context, stride, and corpus protocol permit descriptive inference-time comparison.
limitations: Tokenizer-specific scored token counts differ; evaluation time is not original training compute and each model has one run.

title: Full-test evaluation loss versus parameter count
interpretation: Loss and parameter count are plotted for the same six local checkpoint evaluations.
limitations: Cross-family training data and tokenization differ; one evaluation per model; size is not training compute.

title: Restricted zero-shot benchmark smoke tests
interpretation: Three checkpoints were evaluated on 100 examples per task with score uncertainty; this is separate from the full Pythia-70M validation evaluation.
limitations: CPU FP32 smoke runs on limited examples; no claims about full-split comparative benchmark performance.
